commandDescription.zh-CN: 列出所有可用的嵌套技能及其命令
commandDescription.en-US: List all available nested skills and their commands

footer.zh-CN: 在聊天中输入上述命令即可手动调用对应技能。
footer.en-US: Enter one of the commands above in chat to invoke the corresponding skill.

noSkills.zh-CN: 技能根目录中没有发现可用技能：{roots}
noSkills.en-US: No usable skills were found in the configured roots: {roots}

configCommandInput.zh-CN: 输入技能根目录（多个目录用逗号分隔）
configCommandInput.en-US: Enter skill roots (separate multiple roots with commas)

configCommandUsage.zh-CN: 用法：/config:nested-skills（打开配置输入）或 /config:nested-skills reset（恢复默认值）

configCommandInteractiveOnly.zh-CN: 嵌套技能配置需要在 TUI 中修改；请在交互式 Pi 会话中执行命令。
configCommandInteractiveOnly.en-US: Nested skill configuration requires the TUI; run this command in an interactive Pi session.

configCommandSaved.zh-CN: 嵌套技能配置已保存：{path}。请执行 /reload 使配置生效。
configCommandSaved.en-US: Nested skill configuration saved to {path}. Run /reload to apply it.
